title: Sega Smash Pack Volume 1
text:
Sega Smash Pack Volume 1 is the third compilation to bear the Sega Smash Pack name. It was released for the Sega Dreamcast in 2001 in North America only. It featured twelve games:
 Altered Beast
 Columns
 Golden Axe
 Phantasy Star II
 Revenge of Shinobi
 Sega Swirl
 Shining Force
 Sonic the Hedgehog
 Streets of Rage 2
 Vectorman
 Virtua Cop 2
 Wrestle War

This version of Virtua Cop 2 was based on the Windows port (which in turn is based on the Saturn port of the arcade original) and supports the light gun. The collection was criticized for its poor emulation.
